name: Filana Therapeutics Inc. Common Stock
summary: Filana Therapeutics, Inc. is a company dedicated to pioneering new pharmaceutical products and diagnostic technologies. A key area of its research is focused on creating potential treatments for Alzheimer's disease, including the investigational compounds PTI-125 and PTI-125Dx. Established by Remi Barbier in May 1998, the firm maintains its principal office in Austin, Texas.
